title: KNMI Rotterdam station 344 monthly mean air temperature, 2021–2025
usage_rights: Free use with attribution to KNMI, as stated in the source header
normalization: Arithmetic mean of five source monthly means divided by 10 to degC; no missing months in 2021–2025
evidence_class: A: directly observed official station monthly means; the five-year monthly value is a transparent arithmetic derivation from those measurements
application_status: Measured station series applied as an explicit South-Holland ambient proxy because the exact plant coordinates are not specified; not a plant-site measurement
transferability: South-Holland processing-site ambient proxy only; not feedstock, juice or digester inlet temperature
uncertainty: Interannual variation and station-to-site error not quantified; not a climate normal or measured plant-site condition
